articles.title: Dario Durigan nega 'fórmula mágica' e mantém compromissos fiscais | G1
articles.standfirst: Ministro da Fazenda não fez anúncios de medidas para o equilíbrio das contas públicas, que são aguardadas pelo mercado. Lula recebeu Durigan, ministros e economistas no Palácio da Alvorada nesta quinta.
articles.summary: O ministro Dario Durigan reafirmou os compromissos fiscais do governo após reunião com Lula e economistas, descartando medidas bruscas na política econômica atual.
articles.body:
O ministro da Fazenda, Dario Durigan, afirmou nesta quinta-feira (5) que não há "fórmula mágica" para a economia brasileira e que o governo Lula vai "manter compromissos fiscais" e os feitos durante a campanha eleitoral no plano social.

Durigan deu as declarações durante entrevista a jornalistas após participar de uma reunião, no Palácio da Alvorada, com o presidente Lula, ministros, ex-ministros e economistas . O encontro durou cerca de quatro horas.

Segundo o ministro, não houve discussão sobre medidas específicas.

"Como a gente está dizendo em melhora, avançar, ter superávit nos próximos anos, estamos necessariamente falando em reforçar as regras vigentes hoje de modo que a gente garanta a valorização de políticas públicas de maneira sustentável", afirmou ao ser questionado se haveria necessidade de ajustes nos parâmetros do arcabouço fiscal para estabilização da dívida pública.

📈 O arcabouço fiscal é o conjunto de regras proposto e aprovado em 2023 para orientar os gastos públicos. Ele inclui um sistema de metas e gatilhos para controlar o crescimento das despesas e, em tese, levar os cofres federais para um patamar sustentável de gastos.

O objetivo é conter um crescimento maior da dívida pública brasileira, que já é considerada elevada para o padrão de países emergentes , evitando, assim, um aumento maior da inflação e dos juros básicos, fixados pelo Banco Central, que servem de referência para as taxas cobradas do setor produtivo.

Como desdobramento da conversa, Durigan informou que ele e o ministro do Planejamento, Bruno Moretti, irão analisar os pontos levantados no encontro, além daqueles que já vinham sendo considerados.

A ideia é apresentar ao presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), quando ele retornar de compromissos internacionais, eventuais medidas para avaliação. Ele defendeu que tudo seja feito com "bastante método" e "previsibilidade".

"Acho que a mensagem mais importante é: quem investe, quem produz nesse país não vai ter, neste governo, nenhum problema, nenhuma dificuldade com relação à previsibilidade, regras claras", disse o ministro, completamentando que "faz questão" de comunicar qualquer avanço nesse sentido.

Participaram da reunião com o presidente, além de Dario Durigan, o vice-presidente Geraldo Alckmin, os ministros Bruno Moretti (Planejamento), Miriam Belchior (Casa Civil) e Esther Dweck (Gestão), os ex-ministros Fernando Haddad, Aloizio Mercadante e Guido Mantega, além dos economistas Luciano Coutinho, Eduardo Moreira e Laura Carvalho.

Após o encontro, Durigan não fez anúncios de medidas para equilibrar as contas públicas, que são aguardadas pelo mercado e por especialistas em finanças públicas .

"A gente teve bastante convergência [na reunião], tanto nos diagnósticos quanto nos caminhos para o futuro. Não nos parece haver fórmula mágica e, sim, manutenção dos compromissos fiscais", disse Durigan.

"Compromisso de seguir melhorando as contas públicas, com a manutenção e reforço do que precisa ser reforçado com as regras fiscais atuais. De modo que a gente siga melhorando tanto os indicadores sociais quanto o resultado das contas públicas do governo", acrescentou.

Questionado por jornalistas sobre ações concretas, Durigan afirmou que, na reunião desta quinta, não foram discutidas "medidas específicas". Na sequência, afirmou que o governo tem compromisso de fazer "superávit" nos próximos anos.

No último fim de semana, circulou a informação de que Lula poderia receber para uma conversa André Lara Resende, um dos pais do Plano Real, para avaliar uma ideia do economista de redução da taxa de juros a até 7,5% ao ano, para depois fixar um teto tanto para a inflação como para a taxa Selic do Banco Central.

A ideia foi refutada pelo ministro da Fazenda, Dario Durigan, que negou que o encontro do presidente com o Lara Resende aconteceria e declarou que não haveria mudanças bruscas na política econômica.

A reunião com Lula aconteceu em um momento em que petistas criticam o Banco Central pelos juros altos e pedem mudanças na política monetária.

🔎Nesta quarta-feira, o Banco Central do Brasil interrompeu um ciclo de quedas e manteve em 13,75% ao ano a taxa básica de juros da economia, a Selic.

Além disso, os aliados de Lula rejeitam um ajuste fiscal forte. Enquanto isso, o mercado está na espera do anúncio de medidas de contenção de despesas pelo governo.

Economistas cobram um plano crível e consistente de redução do crescimento das despesas para garantir estabilidade na economia.

Caso contrário, avaliam os especialistas, o país vai conviver com crescimento baixo, falta de recursos para programas e pressões inflacionárias.

Durigan na portaria do Ministério da Fazenda, Brasília - DF — Foto: Washington Costa/MF

articles.title: Ueno Bank: Brasileira relata desespero com dinheiro bloqueado | G1
articles.standfirst: Cearense de 27 anos mora no Paraguai há cinco anos e teve dinheiro usado nas despesas diárias e investimentos bloqueados após intervenção no Ueno Bank.
articles.summary: A cearense Taís Magno relata o impacto da falência do Ueno Bank no Paraguai, que bloqueou economias de 3 milhões de clientes e causou crise no governo local.
articles.body:
A brasileira Taís Magno, de 27 anos, está entre os cerca de 3 milhões de clientes afetados pela crise do Ueno Bank , um dos maiores bancos digitais do Paraguai, que fechou e resultou na renúncia do presidente Santiago Peña .

Natural de Fortaleza (CE) e estudante de Medicina Veterinária, ela vive há cinco anos em Assunção , capital paraguaia, com o marido, que é natural do país. Com o bloqueio das contas, ficou sem acesso ao dinheiro que utilizava para as despesas do dia a dia e aos valores que mantinha investidos.

➡️ Caso Ueno Bank: A instituição, que é a maior emissora de cartões de crédito do Paraguai, enfrenta dificuldades financeiras e também é alvo de investigações. Após uma revisão de seus balanços, o índice de solvência, indicador que mede a capacidade de uma instituição de honrar seus compromissos financeiros, caiu para menos da metade do mínimo exigido pelas autoridades paraguaias.

Taís conta que percebeu a dimensão do problema na manhã da terça-feira (3), quando o Banco Central do Paraguai anunciou a intervenção na instituição. Naquele dia, precisou faltar à faculdade porque não tinha dinheiro em espécie e não conseguiu acessar os recursos pelo aplicativo do banco .

"Eu tinha dinheiro [no banco] para fazer as compras do mês, para o dia a dia. E devido à quebra do banco, nós não podíamos ingressar ao aplicativo do banco. Nós não podemos sacar o dinheiro. Muitas pessoas entraram em desespero porque às vezes é o dinheiro que tem para aquele dia para comer ou para se locomover", relata.

Cearense escolheu banco pelos benefícios oferecidos

Vista aérea mostra a sede do Ueno Bank, em Assunção, no Paraguai. — Foto: Reuters

A cearense é cliente do banco há cerca de três anos. Ela escolheu a instituição por causa dos benefícios oferecidos, como descontos e reembolsos em compras. Em algumas situações, Taís chegava a receber 50% de volta pelos gastos no cartão de crédito.

A dificuldade para acessar o dinheiro também atingiu pessoas próximas. Segundo a estudante, uma vizinha havia acabado de receber o salário do mês, mas o dinheiro ficou retido na instituição. O valor seria utilizado para pagar despesas como aluguel, água e energia.

Ela também conta que se sentiu culpada por ter recomendado o banco a uma amiga, que investiu 1.000 dólares na instituição na mesma semana da intervenção.

Crise abala confiança em instituições financeiras

Brasileira tem dificuldades após ter dinheiro bloqueado em banco fechado no Paraguai — Foto: Arquivo pessoal

Agora, Taís tenta reorganizar a vida financeira e afirma que a crise abalou sua confiança nas instituições financeiras . Sem acesso aos recursos que mantinha no Ueno Bank, ela precisou recorrer ao cartão de crédito brasileiro, mesmo com a cobrança adicional de IOF .

A estudante também tentou abrir contas em outras cinco instituições financeiras paraguaias, mas só conseguiu na sexta tentativa . Isso porque os clientes precisam ter uma conta em outra instituição bancária para receber os valores bloqueados após a intervenção. Segundo ela, a procura por novos bancos aumentou desde o anúncio da medida, o que tem dificultado a abertura de novas contas no país.

Sobre a recuperação do dinheiro, Taís relata que recebeu a informação de que os clientes poderiam ter os valores liberados em um prazo de 15 a 30 dias , com a transferência dos recursos para outra instituição bancária. A expectativa, agora, é conseguir recuperar o dinheiro e retomar a normalidade financeira.

A legislação paraguaia prevê que a garantia dos depósitos seja paga em até 15 dias corridos após a aprovação da resolução da instituição financeira, prazo que pode ser prorrogado por mais 15 dias , mediante decisão fundamentada do Banco Central.

Apesar da crise, Taís afirma que continua tendo uma avaliação positiva do Paraguai e das condições de vida que encontrou no país. Ela conta que decidiu se mudar para lá com o marido justamente pelas facilidades para construir uma vida familiar, como a carga tributária reduzida e o acesso mais fácil à compra de imóveis, automóveis e eletrodomésticos.

Para a cearense, o episódio envolvendo o Ueno Bank é uma situação pontual e não representa o funcionamento geral do país.

articles.title: 'Recebemos e acordamos no outro dia sem nada do dinheiro', diz mulher que teve valores bloqueados após quebra do Ueno Bank no Paraguai | G1
articles.standfirst: Após decisão do Banco Central do Paraguai, serviços do Ueno Bank foram suspensos, cartões e aplicativo da instituição deixaram de funcionar, e clientes encontraram as agências com as portas fechadas.
articles.summary: Após decisão do Banco Central do Paraguai, serviços do Ueno Bank foram suspensos, aplicativo da instituição deixou de funcionar, e clientes encontraram as agências fechadas.
articles.body:
A crise envolvendo o Ueno Bank, um dos maiores bancos digitais do Paraguai, afeta cerca de 3 milhões de clientes, entre eles, a empreendedora Jhenifer Vogado.

Filha de brasileiros, moradora de Santa Rosa del Monday, cidade que fica a cerca de 57 quilômetros de Foz do Iguaçu , ela precisou recorrer à ajuda de familiares para comprar medicamentos para o filho de 3 anos, que está doente, depois de ter a conta bloqueada.

Ela e o marido usavam o Ueno como banco principal e tinham conta na instituição há cerca de 4 anos.

"A gente dependia dele para tudo: para pagar mercado, para pagar internet, para pagar a luz, para fazer transferência, para tudo. A gente dormiu com o salário que recebemos no começo do mês e acordamos no outro dia sem nada do dinheiro, nada", detalha.

O Ueno, maior emissor de cartões de crédito do Paraguai, vinha enfrentando problemas financeiros e é alvo de investigações. Após ajustes em balanços, o índice de solvência da instituição, que indica a capacidade de cumprir obrigações financeiras, caiu para menos da metade do mínimo exigido.

Diante da situação, na madrugada de terça-feira (3), o Banco Central do Paraguai anunciou um procedimento para proteger os depositantes e reduzir os possíveis impactos da crise sobre o sistema financeiro. Com isso, os serviços do Ueno foram suspensos, cartões e aplicativo da instituição deixaram de funcionar, e clientes encontraram as agências do banco com as portas fechadas.

Jhenifer afirma que soube do caso pelas redes sociais e, desde então, passou a lidar com a incerteza. Segundo ela, não houve qualquer comunicação oficial por parte do Ueno, e todas as informações que recebeu até o momento vieram da imprensa paraguaia.

"Eu não tinha a cabeça para nada. Meu emocional estava abaladíssimo. Foi um sentimento de tristeza, porque, além de nós estarmos precisando, tem mais famílias que estão sem dinheiro. Por sorte, a gente tem alguém que possa nos emprestar, mas e as pessoas que não têm? Que dependiam desse salário do mês? Como que essas pessoas ficam sem comida, sem acesso a remédio?", lamentou.

Estudante brasileira conseguiu pagar o aluguel, mas ficou com dinheiro para a conta de luz bloqueado

Moradora de Ciudad del Leste, a médica Vanessa Monteiro conseguiu pagar o aluguel antes do bloqueio, mas ficou sem acesso ao dinheiro que usaria para pagar as contas de casa, como a da energia.

"Eu espero que as pessoas que estão com dinheiro preso consigam o mais rápido possível, mesmo que seja pouco dinheiro, mas que consigam logo, porque é um dinheiro que a gente já espera, para poder pagar as contas e, do nada, fica preso e não tem mais acesso", desabafa.

Também estudante de medicina, a brasileira Camila Brito não teve a mesma sorte em Assunção, capital do Paraguai. Com valores e investimentos bloqueados, ela precisou renegociar o aluguel e outras questões financeiras previstas para esses dias.

"É uma situação muito complicada acordar e não ter acesso nenhum ao seu próprio dinheiro, ainda mais no dia seguinte ao tradicional dia de pagamento dos salários. Isso significa que as pessoas, inclusive nós, havíamos acabado de receber e não tínhamos como cumprir as nossas obrigações financeiras. No geral, as pessoas estão sendo solidárias e permitindo que as despesas sejam renegociadas. O que resta agora é esperar que os valores sejam desbloqueados o mais rápido possível", afirma.

'A gente está à deriva, não sabe o que faz'

Ueno Bank no Paraguai — Foto: Marcos Landim/RPC

Ainda não há um levantamento oficial sobre quantos brasileiros foram afetados pela suspensão das operações do Ueno Bank.

Entre os atingidos, estão muitos brasileiros que vivem no Paraguai e mantinham contas na instituição devido à facilidade para movimentar recursos e realizar transferências entre os sistemas bancários dos dois países.

O médico José Gabriel, que trabalha no Paraguai, usava uma conta no banco para receber os pagamentos. Segundo ele, os correntistas vivem um cenário de incerteza diante dos desdobramentos da crise, marcada pela renúncia do presidente do Paraguai, do presidente do Banco Central do país e pela falta de respostas sobre o futuro dos recursos depositados.

"A gente está à deriva, a gente não sabe o que faz, e infelizmente nosso dinheiro está lá preso e a gente não sabe o que fazer", afirma.

Antes da renúncia do presidente paraguaio Santiago Peña, ele havia anunciado medidas para ressarcir os clientes afetados pela dissolução do banco . Em uma publicação no X, Peña afirmou que pretende iniciar os pagamentos ainda nesta semana, caso o Congresso aprove uma lei que autorize a medida.

articles.title: Governo define lista de minerais críticos e estratégicos; veja quais são  | G1
articles.standfirst: Definição está prevista na Política Nacional de Minerais Críticos e Estratégico aprovada pelo Congresso e sancionada pelo presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) em setembro.
articles.summary: Definição está prevista na Política Nacional de Minerais Críticos e Estratégico aprovada pelo Congresso e sancionada pelo presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) em setembro.
articles.body:
Entenda projeto aprovado no Senado que cria regras para exploração de terras raras e outras riquezas minerais brasileiras — Foto: Jornal Nacional/ Reprodução

O Conselho Nacional para Industrialização de Minerais Críticos e Estratégicos (CIMCE) aprovou, nesta quinta-feira (05), a lista dos minerais qualificados como críticos e estratégicos para o país. Entre eles estão terras raras, grafita, níquel, potássio e nióbio. (veja mais abaixo).

Esses minerais têm aplicações em áreas diversas, como transição energética, digitalização, defesa e indústria de alta tecnologia.

Segundo o governo federal, os minerais foram distribuídos em três classes (prioridade alta, média e baixa), observando a importância deles para o país em termos de soberania e industrialização e considerando fatores como risco geopolítico, concentração geográfica da produção - e potencial de substituição.

"A adoção desse rol funcionará como a verdadeira bússola da política mineral brasileira, entregando ao setor produtivo o seu ativo mais valioso: a previsibilidade. Na prática, a entrada de uma substância na lista é o que aciona o mecanismo de triagem de investimentos, garantindo a proteção e a soberania nacional em operações societárias estratégicas, e estabelece o marco para as regras de transição de projetos que já estão em andamento", afirmou o Ministério de Minas e Energia em nota.

O Conselho Nacional para Industrialização de Minerais Críticos e Estratégicos é o espaço de coordenação da Política Nacional de Minerais Críticos e Estratégicos (PNMCE).

A política tem o objetivo de ampliar a agregação de valor em território nacional, estimulando a pesquisa e a lavra, bem como o beneficiamento, a transformação e a mineração urbana.

🔎A política considera como críticos os minerais cujo abastecimento está sujeito a riscos capazes de afetar setores essenciais da economia.

🔎Já os estratégicos são aqueles considerados importantes para o desenvolvimento tecnológico e regional, para a balança comercial ou para a redução das emissões de gases de efeito estufa.

Esta foi a primeira reunião do pleno do Conselho, que é formado por diversos ministérios, como o da Fazenda e das Relações Exteriores, e entidades da sociedade civil. Além da lista dos minerais qualificados como críticos e estratégicos, também foi discutido o regimento interno do conselho.

O governo planeja realizar uma nova reunião no início de dezembro. Na ocasião, devem ser reguladas as cadeias produtivas prioritárias. A etapa é considerada importante para o avanço dos incentivos no setor.

articles.title: HCG Q2 revenue grows 16% to Rs 732 cr
articles.summary: HCG Q2 consolidated revenue rose 16% YoY to Rs 731.8 crore on higher patient volumes, ARPP gains and improved margins; non-institutional share hit 69%.
articles.body: HCG Q2 revenue grows 16% to Rs 732 crTimes News NetworkBengaluruCancer care specialist HealthCare Global Enterprises (HCG) reported a 16% year-on-year increase in consolidated revenue to Rs 731.8 crore for the September quarter, driven by higher patient volumes and improved revenue per patient.Patient volumes increased 9% year-on-year, while average revenue per patient (ARPP) rose 7%, supported by a favourable payer mix and a higher contribution from advanced oncology treatments. Its margins improved to 19.7% from 19.2% in the year-ago quarter.Revenue growth was also supported by a shift towards non-institutional patients, whose contribution to overall revenue increased by 325 basis points year-on-year to 69%.Dr Manish Mattoo, CEO of HCG, said the company was seeing higher contributions from complex oncology treatments and operational efficiencies. “Our strategic emphasis on expanding the non-institutional business continues to enhance the quality of revenue, with its share improving by 325 basis points year-on-year to 69%,” he said.The company’s international business recorded a 54% increase in revenue to Rs 30.2 crore during the quarter, supported by higher patient volumes in radiation and medical oncology.HCG added 25 operational beds during the quarter, including 13 in Kenya, seven in Kolkata and five in Nagpur. This took the total number of beds added during the first half of FY27 to 146.The company also expanded its advanced technology capabilities, operationalising an MR-LINAC adaptive radiation therapy system at its North Bengaluru facility, a linear accelerator (LINAC) in Africa and a cardiac robotic surgery system at HMS Ahmedabad.Dr B S Ajaikumar, founder and non-executive chairman of HCG, said the company was strengthening its research capabilities in areas such as multi-omics, organoid technology, cellular therapies, including CAR-T, and longevity research.“Our endeavour is to bridge the gap between research and clinical practice, enabling us to better understand the biology of cancer, develop innovative treatment approaches and continually improve patient outcomes,” he said.You use AI every day. articles.title: InMobi appoints Hema Namburi as group CFO
articles.summary: InMobi names Hema Namburi group CFO; the longtime leader and global financial controller since 2018 brings 20 years of finance, audit and compliance experience.
articles.body: BengaluruInMobi has appointed Hema Namburi as its group chief financial officer (CFO). Namburi, who has been associated with the company for over 14 years across two stints, has served as its global financial controller since 2018.She brings nearly two decades of experience across finance, audit, taxation and regulatory compliance. Her association with InMobi began in 2010, when she joined its finance function and later rose to senior manager – finance. She returned to the company in 2018 after a two-and-a-half-year stint as vice-president – finance at FreshMenu.Earlier, she worked with KPMG India in statutory audits, financial reporting and internal controls, and began her career with Infosys in 2006 in financial planning and analysis.Naveen Tewari, founder and CEO of InMobi and Glance, said Namburi’s institutional knowledge and experience in managing financial operations across geographies would strengthen the company’s finance function. “She has played an important role in strengthening our financial processes and governance over the years,” he said.You use AI every day. articles.title: Canva redefine los despidos en la era de la IA: reestructura el 22% de su plantilla con un generoso paquete de compensación
articles.standfirst: La tecnológica australiana ofrece un generoso paquete de compensación
articles.summary: La tecnológica australiana ofrece un generoso paquete de compensación
articles.body: La empresa australiana Canva ha anunciado una drástica reestructuración integral que afectará a 1.271 trabajadores, el 22% de su plantilla global, argumentando la necesidad de simplificar su modelo organizativo ante el avance de la inteligencia artificial (IA) y la desaceleración de su crecimiento. A pesar de ser una medida dura, el movimiento ha sido calificado por analistas como una “clase magistral” o manual de gestión de crisis, contrastando fuertemente con la frialdad con la que habitualmente despiden otras empresas del sector tecnológico. Según ha explicado su cofundadora y CEO, Melanie Perkins, se enfrentan al "año más difícil de su historia" tras ralentizar sus ingresos por primera vez en una década. Herramientas generativas avanzadas (como Claude de Anthropic o los generadores de imágenes integrados de OpenAI y Google) permiten hacer tareas de diseño complejas de forma automatizada. Esto reduce la necesidad de subespecializaciones dentro del propio software y exige estructuras más ágiles. Para competir en esta nueva era, Canva busca eliminar capas burocráticas y volver a su filosofía original de equipos pequeños, autónomos y coubicados, forzando además el regreso a las oficinas en Sídney un mínimo de dos a tres días por semana. Esta reestructuración se produce también en un contexto financiero estratégico en el que busca optimizar al máximo su eficiencia operativa de cara a una inminente salida a bolsa. A diferencia de las que realizan despidos masivos de forma repentina, dicha compañía ofrece un generoso paquete de compensación y asistencia para amortiguar el impacto económico y profesional de los 1.271 afectados: incluye un mínimo de seis meses de salario garantizados, hasta 12 meses de cobertura médica continua pagada o una subvención de 10.000 dólares en efectivo para aquellos que deseen iniciar su propio negocio.

articles.title: What Anthropic's IPO could mean for Amazon and Google
articles.summary: Anthropic's IPO could payoff for Amazon and Google.
articles.body:
Anthropic ( ANTH.PVT ) is preparing for what could be a historic initial public offering (IPO) later this month, with Wall Street expecting the company to launch with a valuation of between $1.5 trillion and $2 trillion.

A public debut at the top end would put Anthropic ahead of SpaceX ( SPCX ) for the most valuable stock market IPO in history.

That would make plenty of people a whole lot richer on paper virtually overnight, including big-name investors like Amazon ( AMZN ) and Google ( GOOG , GOOGL ), two of the company's largest backers.

The tech giants have invested billions of dollars in Anthropic, and, according to the AI lab's amended S-1 investor prospectus , the pair will hold more than 5% of Anthropic's outstanding stock when it goes public.

But those hefty investments also carry substantial risks if the company falls short of Wall Street's enormous expectations.

"There's risk to their investment in that … who knows in five years whether Anthropic will be the most profitable company in the world — or worth nothing," Dorothy Lund, co-director of Columbia Law School's Ira M. Millstein Center for Global Markets and Corporate Ownership , told Yahoo Finance.

According to Amazon's latest quarterly filing , the company has invested $18 billion in Anthropic so far, and currently has a financing agreement with the startup worth up to an additional $15 billion.

As of Sept. 30, those investments were worth $92.5 billion in Anthropic nonvoting preferred stock. Amazon also said it holds $146.2 billion in notes, which would convert to stock when Anthropic goes public.

Google doesn't break out the exact value of individual investments, but in April it revealed plans to invest upwards of $40 billion in the company if it meets certain performance obligations . That's in addition to prior investments worth roughly $3 billion.

Anthropic and Google aren't just investors in Anthropic; they are also major compute suppliers.

In May, The Information reported that Anthropic entered into a $200 billion agreement to use Google's Tensor Processing Units (TPUs) over a five-year period. Anthropic has also agreed to spend more than $100 billion via Amazon's AWS over the next 10 years.

That means in addition to investment gains, the cloud giants will also earn revenue on sales to Anthropic. Such deals have frequently raised concerns about circular investing, creating an unsustainable trend in the AI market.

It gets more interesting when you consider that Amazon and Google also compete with Anthropic. Google has its Google DeepMind frontier lab that develops its own AI models that go toe-to-toe with Anthropic's, and, according to Business Insider , Amazon is refocusing its AI efforts to better compete in the frontier space.

articles.title: Here's what to do with your retirement savings in a market sell-off
articles.summary: Should you rebalance your portfolio in a volatile market? It can be tempting to make big moves when the markets are volatile, but experts advise caution.
articles.body:
Some offers on this page are from advertisers who pay us, which may affect which products we write about, but not our recommendations. See our Advertiser Disclosure .

The stock market plummeted on Thursday, unwinding the previous day's rally, as investors weighed the impact of a Democratic midterm election sweep on the outlook for data centers and AI .

Tech stocks led the decline, with the Nasdaq Composite ( ^IXIC) plunging over 5% and entering a correction. The Dow Jones Industrial Average ( ^DJI ) fell over 3%, and the S&P 500 index ( ^GSPC ) ended down over 4%.

We talked to several experts about whether it's best to stay the course or adjust retirement-targeted holdings.

Here's what experts say about managing your retirement savings when the markets are shaky.

The truth is that retirement savers can't afford to be rash. Building wealth is a long-term process.

"In times of stock market volatility, I tell my clients that it's crucial to remember that such fluctuations are a natural part of investing," Ryan Haiss, a certified financial planner at Flynn Zito Capital Management in Garden City, N.Y., told Yahoo Finance.

If you're tempted to do something major, tap the brakes.

It's pretty tough to find the best time to sell and buy stocks. If you get out when markets dip, you might very well miss out on the upside when they get rolling again.

The bigger issue is not what goes down this week, but what happened over the last year. The reality is that stocks do have market risk, but even those of you close to retirement or retired should stay invested in stocks to some degree in order to benefit from the upside over time.

If you're 65, you could have two decades or more of living ahead of you and you'll want that potential boost.

"Stay calm is my mantra," Justin Smith, a certified financial planner with Savant Wealth Management in Phoenix, Ariz., told Yahoo Finance. Smith tells his clients "to focus on what we can control, such as their retirement plan and cash holdings, and acknowledge that much of this is out of our control."

Automatic retirement savings and target funds to the rescue

If you're setting money aside automatically in your employer-sponsored retirement plan, or you're making automatic contributions to a Roth IRA or a traditional IRA and are years from retirement, take a breath.

You're constantly investing in your retirement accounts when the market is soaring and when it's down, and that means the return on your investments evens out over the long run, especially when you have decades of runway ahead.

And if you're like many retirement savers, you have bought into the simplicity of target-date retirement funds so your account is automatically adjusting for market gyrations.

With a target-date retirement fund, you select the year you'd like to retire and buy a mutual fund with that year in its name (like Target 2044). The fund manager then splits up your investment between stocks and bonds, changing that division to a more conservative blend as the target date looms, or soon after.

It's fine for younger savers with decades until retirement to sit tight and wait it out. In fact, stop looking at your account balances right now until things quiet down again.

But for those closer to retirement age, that might not be best.

"The mantra to do nothing when the market drops isn't necessarily great advice for people approaching retirement," Christine Benz, Morningstar's director of personal finance, told Yahoo Finance.

"It has been very easy to let stocks ride during their extended run over the past decade, and people's portfolios are the better for it," she said. "But if they haven't rebalanced and taken risk out of their portfolio by lightening up on stocks, it's still reasonable to do that, even though stocks have dropped a bit."

Her advice: Pre-retirees and retirees should hold five to 10 years' worth of anticipated portfolio withdrawals in a combination of cash and high-quality bonds.

"Those assets provide a bulwark against having to withdraw from stock assets if stocks encounter a sustained downturn," she said. "And the good news is that yields on bonds and cash, while they've declined a bit recently in expectation of Fed rate cuts, are still quite decent relative to where they were a few years ago."

In fact, some certificates of deposit and high-yield savings accounts are paying more than 4%. The most appealing CD rates — offered mostly by online banks — were recently hovering around 4.7% for a one-year certificate.

Many retirees want a more conservative asset mix as they age so they don't have to get that anxious feeling when the stock market slides. That's why near-retirees and retirees, in particular, who haven't revisited their asset allocations for a while should consider doing so, Benz said.

Financial advisers generally suggest rebalancing (adjusting the mix of your stocks and bonds) whenever your portfolio gets more than 7% to 10% away from your original asset allocation, which was constructed to match your time horizon, risk tolerance, and financial goals. To roughly determine what percentage of your portfolio should be in stocks, subtract your age from 110. So, a 60-year-old would have 50% in stocks and the rest in bonds and cash.

This is an opportune time to step back, review your overall retirement account investments and how they are allocated, and consider some fine-tuning. If having too big a chunk of your savings invested in stocks makes you a hot mess when markets swing, then you might consider paring those holdings back a bit.

"If this decline has you feeling your investments are too aggressive, it's a good time to revisit your portfolio allocation," Haiss said. "However, you may want to hold off on making any changes until the market recovers."

While I held off on bothering my adviser this time, I make it a point to meet with her throughout the year to review allocations and revisit my overall retirement outlook and risk tolerance. In our last meeting, in fact, we both marveled at how the S&P 500 has nearly doubled since the spring of 2020.

I highly recommend you do the same with your financial planner. You might decide to stay on course or make a very minor tweak, so when things go haywire in the market — and they will from time to time — you'll feel less fearful. This is something within your control.

articles.title: Precio de la luz por horas mañana viernes 6 de noviembre: cuándo es más barata y más cara
articles.standfirst: El precio de la luz se encarece este viernes en 2.91
articles.summary: El precio de la luz se encarece este viernes en 2.91
articles.body: El precio medio de la electricidad en el día de hoy es de 245,63 €/MWh, lo que representa un incremento de 6,94 € respecto al día anterior, que se situó en 238,69 €/MWh. Este aumento se produce un viernes, cuando tradicionalmente se intensifica la demanda. Analizaremos a continuación las horas más caras y más baratas del día para entender mejor las tarifas actuales. Los precios de la luz alcanzan sus niveles más elevados entre las 18:00 y las 21:00, evidenciando una clara tendencia de concentración durante las horas pico del consumo energético. En este bloque, las franjas horarias más destacadas son: 18:00 - 19:00 con un precio de 300.67 €/MWh, 19:00 - 20:00 a 296.83 €/MWh y 20:00 - 21:00 a 294.94 €/MWh. Este aumento continuo en los precios durante estas horas coinciden con el máximo consumo de energía, resaltando la necesidad de gestionar la demanda de manera eficiente. La luz es más barata entre la medianoche y la mañana, presentando oportunidades de ahorro durante las primeras horas del día. Las franjas horarias destacadas son entre las 00:00 - 03:00, donde los precios se mantienen por debajo de los 230 €/MWh, alcanzando el mínimo con 225.12 €/MWh a las 03:00 - 04:00. También se observa una ventana de precios accesibles entre las 10:00 - 12:00, cuando los valores oscilan entre 198.53 €/MWh y 212.48 €/MWh, lo que permite a los consumidores aprovechar tramos consecutivos de tarifas reducidas. El análisis de las franjas horarias revela una marcada concentración de precios elevados durante las horas pico, especialmente entre las 18:00 y las 21:00, donde las tarifas superan notablemente los 290 €/MWh. Esta tendencia es relevante para los consumidores, ya que sugiere que es crucial gestionar el consumo durante estos periodos para evitar gastos excesivos.

articles.title: Mistry questions Noel's eligibility for Bai Hirabai trust
articles.summary: MUMBAI: Mehli Mistry, former trustee of the Bai Hirabai Jamsetji Tata Navsari Charitable Institution, has contested Noel Tata's qualification to sit on
articles.body: MUMBAI: Mehli Mistry, former trustee of the Bai Hirabai Jamsetji Tata Navsari Charitable Institution, has contested Noel Tata's qualification to sit on the same board under the trust's century-old deed, raising questions about his faith, citizenship and residence.In a rejoinder filed before the Maharashtra Charity Commissioner on Thursday, Mistry sought directions requiring Noel to file an affidavit confirming he meets the 1923 deed's criteria: That he is a practising Parsi Zoroastrian and a permanent resident of either Bombay Presidency or Navsari.Mistry alleged that Noel "is not practising the Zoroastrian faith". He also asked for affidavits from every trustee, "especially the former and the current reporting trustee" and offered to file his own.The rejoinder is the sharpest personal challenge to Noel's position at one of the smaller Tata-linked trusts.It follows a reply by Bai Hirabai on Oct 14, which had argued that Mistry had no standing to object to the cessation of his trusteeship.The trust had said: "The objector (Mistry) is a citizen of the UK and not India and a tax resident of the UAE."'Noel is an Irish citizen and tax resident of UAE'Responding to a Bai Hirabai reply on Oct 14, Mehli Mistry said neither the will, codicil nor deed of the trust prescribes any qualification based on citizenship or tax residence. He said he remains a Parsi Zoroastrian with a residence in Colaba, Mumbai. He also said the trust contradicted itself: it argued that the deed's residence requirement was void, yet used his residence against him.Mistry then turned to Noel, the son of Naval Tata, a Parsi, and Simone Tata, a Swiss-born Catholic. He described him as "an Irish citizen, tax resident of UAE, a golden resident visa holder and therefore, a resident of the UAE."Mistry asked for an affidavit stating whether Noel is a tax resident of India. It should also say whether he was an Indian or Irish citizen when appointed, and why his citizenship changed. Mistry said, to the best of his knowledge, Noel's mother held a Swiss passport. He asked whether Noel had held a Swiss passport while holding an Indian one."The trust cannot demand scrutiny of the objector (Mistry) while claiming exemption from the same scrutiny for its own reporting trustee (Noel)," the rejoinder said. It added that the trust "cannot be permitted to approbate and reprobate by selectively relying upon the provisions of the trust deed".Similarly, Venu Srinivasan and Vijay Singh, he alleged, are neither Zoroastrians nor permanent residents of Bombay Presidency or Navsari. They and Noel were the trustees who rejected his reappointment. "How can a change be recognised when the very persons who voted upon it were themselves not legally entitled to do so?" he asked.Singh filed the original change report, giving a New Delhi address. Noel applied on Oct 9 to be substituted as reporting trustee. He asked the trust to state on affidavit whether Singh was qualified to file the report. Clause 6 of the deed says "all of the trustees shall be Zoroastrians".Bai Hirabai said Mistry's three-year term expired on Oct 28, 2025. Mistry argued that "the trust deed prescribes no tenure; the trusteeship is for life".Bai Hirabai had relied on a March 2000 opinion by former Chief Justice of India M H Kania, which held the eligibility restrictions "bad in law". Kania's reasoning rested on a codicil to Sir Ratan Tata's will, which the trust says imposed no restrictions on ethnicity, race or religion. Mistry said a "private opinion" cannot override a registered deed. The first non-Parsi trustee was appointed in July 1999, he noted, nine months before the opinion.You use AI every day. articles.title: DraftKings Plunges on 2027 Forecast That Misses Estimates
articles.summary: DraftKings Inc. gave a forecast for earnings in 2027 that missed the average analyst estimate, while also cutting its outlook for fiscal 2026. Third-quarter...
articles.body:
(Bloomberg) -- DraftKings Inc. gave a forecast for earnings in 2027 that missed the average analyst estimate, while also cutting its outlook for fiscal 2026. Third-quarter revenue also fell short of expectations. The shares fell 19% in extended trading.

The Boston-based sports-betting giant sees adjusted earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortization of $800 million to $1 billion, the company said in a statement Thursday. That is less than the $1.12 billion analysts were expecting on average, according to data compiled by Bloomberg.

For fiscal year 2026, the company now expects revenue of $6.35 billion to $6.55 billion and adjusted earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortization of $175 million to $275 million. Previous guidance was for $6.5 billion to $6.9 billion in revenue and adjusted Ebitda of $700 million to $900 million.

This new range primarily reflects the company's increased adjusted Ebitda investment in predictions of $650 million to $700 million, the company said.

DraftKings and its chief rival Flutter Entertainment Plc.'s FanDuel have struggled with sport-betting outcomes that have been more favorable to their customers. They've also been coping with competition from a new generation of prediction-market operators like Kalshi Inc. and Polymarket.

FanDuel and DraftKings have both launched their own prediction-market products, focusing on states were sports-betting is not legal. Rolling out the new products is expensive, however, eating into company profits.

In the third quarter, DraftKings company reported revenue of $1.33 billion, missing analysts' estimates of $1.39 billion. Monthly players increased 13% to 4.1 million, compared with with analysts' average projections for 4 million.

articles.title: Intel's stock crash shares an uncanny resemblance to its 2000 bust
articles.summary: Intel stock's 26-year comeback and subsequent reckoning this year carry an eerie echo of its dot-com days.
articles.body:
Intel ( INTC ) stock's 26-year comeback and subsequent reckoning this year carry an eerie echo of its dot-com days.

On Thursday, the chipmaker's stock reached a 58% peak-to-trough decline over 30 trading days from its Sept. 24 close of $127.39. This latest drawdown was sharper than Intel's dot-com bust in 2000, when the stock fell 53% from its Aug. 31, 2000, close of $74.88 to its Oct. 11, 2000, close of $35.38 in 28 days.

Since June, Intel has erased about $460 billion in its market capitalization.

2026 has been the best of times and the worst of times for the chip giant. Earlier this year, Intel shattered its 2000s-era record high multiple times, climbing to an all-time high of $140.94 in June, as the artificial intelligence boom boosted CPU sales and Intel's new CEO Lip-Bu Tan laid out ambitious plans for new products.

In recent weeks, the stock has gotten hit just as hard in the other direction, suffering its worst single-day drop since 1974 after reporting third quarter earnings on Oct. 29 . The stock collapsed after Intel's forecast for fourth quarter revenue fell short of expectations due to a worse-than-expected decline in PC sales.

Intel hasn't recovered from that rout, and Thursday's broad-based chip stock wipeout only exacerbated the declines. Intel stock dropped another 10% to $52.25 per share by Thursday's close.

While Intel's round trip over the past five months has been ugly, the picture looks rosier when you zoom out. Year to date, Intel stock remains up roughly 42%.

"This is a company that got out ahead of itself," Futurum CEO Daniel Newman told Yahoo Finance last Friday. "I don't think [CEO Lip-Bu Tan] ever asked for it to go up sevenfold. I think if you've actually talked to him, he would say the stock ran well ahead of where it should have been. It was a narrative bet, not an execution bet."

articles.title: Equity Volatility Jumps Most Since April 2025 Tariff Turmoil
articles.summary: The cost to hedge against the biggest S&P 500 plunge in more than a year soared on Thursday as traders sought cover from further wild swings.
articles.body:
(Bloomberg) -- The cost to hedge against the biggest S&P 500 plunge in more than a year soared on Thursday as traders sought cover from further wild swings.

The Cboe Volatility Index, or VIX, measuring expected volatility in the US benchmark and a key gauge of market stress, rose the most since April 2025 as the S&P 500 dropped 4.4% and the Nasdaq 100 slid more than 6%. The cost of VIX options rose even more, jumping faster than at any time since the Volmageddon episode in 2018.

The stress was most apparent in short-term contracts. The backwardation, or premium of first-month to second-month VIX futures contracts, reached the highest level in almost a year. In S&P 500 Index options, the contracts that feed into the VIX calculation, bid-ask spreads widened out, another sign of market stress.

"Generally hedges bought and added, while we saw some dip buying in spots, the vast majority of flow was monetizing/rolling/adding protection," said Daniel Kirsch, head of options at Piper Sandler. "Toward the close was the first time it felt like capitulation, with the spike higher in fixed strike volatility."

Overall volume of VIX options was triple the 20-day average and at 3.13 million contracts was the highest since volatility spiked in August 2024 when the market plunged on the unwinding of the yen carry trade. But the trading wasn't all one way. The VIX put-call ratio was around 0.7, the highest since July, signaling that investors weren't just chasing calls all day.

Meanwhile, the Cboe NDX Volatility Index, a version of the VIX based on the Nasdaq 100 Index, soared to its highest level since April 11, 2025, during that month's tariff driven turmoil.

"Markets were wide," said Jason Coogan, a floor trader a Simplex Trading. "Every rally in market was met with resistance."

articles.title: Retail traders dump $265 million in stocks in biggest selling day since 2020
articles.summary: Retail investors are dumping US stocks at a pace not seen since the onset of the COVID-19 pandemic, breaking with their typical market-down-day habit of "buy...
articles.body:
Retail investors dumped US stocks on Thursday at a pace not seen since the onset of the COVID-19 pandemic, breaking with their typical market-down-day habit of "buying the dip."

Everyday investors sold a net $265 million in individual US stocks on Thursday, according to Vanda Research, the biggest single-day net selling spree since March 17, 2020, when retail investors pulled $502 million from individual stocks.

"This is what we would call a total capitulation by retail investors," Viraj Patel, global macro strategist at Vanda Research, said in emailed comments.

US stocks plunged on Thursday as AI and chip stocks sold off, erasing the gains from Wednesday's post-election rally. The tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite ( ^IXIC ) dropped 5.2%, putting the index on track to close in a correction.

Retail selling marks something of a departure from a tendency by individual investors in recent years to scoop up shares when markets tumble. Vanda said there were "no signs of buying the dip" in individual stocks, though some investors continued to purchase leveraged exchange-traded funds such as ProShares UltraPro QQQ ( TQQQ ) and Direxion Daily Semiconductor Bull 3X Shares ( SOXL ).

Vanda added that net selling was a third higher earlier Thursday afternoon before late "late-session" retail buyers stepped in

Patel added that the retreat echoed a broader "buyers' strike" among institutional investors alongside forced selling by systematic and leveraged investment strategies.

articles.title: In fresh salvo, Mehli Mistry targets Tata Trusts' directors
articles.summary: Mistry urges commissioner to rule on earnings Of Tata Trusts nominees on Tata Sons board MUMBAI: Former Sir Dorabji Tata Trust (SDTT) trustee Mehli Mistry
articles.body: Mistry urges commissioner to rule on earnings Of Tata Trusts nominees on Tata Sons boardMUMBAI: Former Sir Dorabji Tata Trust (SDTT) trustee Mehli Mistry on Thursday urged the Maharashtra Charity Commissioner (MCC) to rule that commissions earned by Tata Trusts-nominated directors on the board of Tata Sons belong to the charitable trusts and should be remitted to them, not retained personally.Mistry argued that such directors hold those positions solely by virtue of the trusts' shareholding in Tata Sons and therefore act in a representative and fiduciary capacity. Citing section 88 of the Indian Trusts Act, he contended that a fiduciary who uses his position to obtain a financial advantage must account for it to the beneficiary."The issue of taking commissions by the nominated director of the trust ought to be adjudicated by the charity commissioner," Mistry said.To bolster his argument, Mistry pointed to practices followed by public sector enterprises and statutory bodies where representatives appointed to outside bodies in their official capacities are prohibited from drawing commissions or retaining financial incentives."Such amounts are not intended to be retained as personal earnings by the representatives but are required to be accounted for in favour of the institution," he said.According to Mistry, the obligation is even more compelling in the case of a public charitable trust because trustees and their nominees are entrusted with assets dedicated to public and charitable purposes.SDTT and Sir Ratan Tata Trust (SRTT) together own about 52% of Tata Sons and jointly nominate one-third of its board under the company's articles of association (Article 104B). Tata Trusts currently have two nominees on the Tata Sons board: Trusts chairman Noel Tata and vice-chairman Venu Srinivasan. According to Tata Sons' FY2026 report, Noel received a commission of Rs 3 crore, while Srinivasan received none. Vijay Singh, a trustee who sat on the Tata Sons board, received about Rs 1.4 crore. He left the board in FY2026.Mistry's demand is part of his legal battle with SDTT before the MCC and linked to his exit. He said the dispute raised broader governance questions relating to the administration of trust property."Whether commissions earned by reason of the Trusts' shareholding (in Tata Sons) belong to the Trusts, whether conflicts of interest were declared...are therefore questions about the administration of SDTT and its property. They lie at the core of sections 41A and 41D of the Maharashtra Public Trusts Act," Mistry said.He pointed to conflict-of-interest in Srinivasan's engagement of former Jaguar Land Rover design chief Gerry McGovern for TVS Motor-owned Norton Motorcycles, and Noel's participation in decisions on capital support for Tata International, where he is chairman.In 2025, Noel, Srinivasan and Singh had blocked Mistry's trusteeship extension, ending his tenure at SDTT and SRTT. Mistry said the removal was illegal.You use AI every day. Now get your AI Quotient. Take the AIQ test.
